scripts.web:e2e:responsive: npm --workspace apps/web exec -- playwright test mobile-responsive.spec.ts --project=mobile
scripts.web:e2e:prod-mobile: STONKS_E2E_BASE_URL=https://stonks.sookyungahn.com npm --workspace apps/web exec -- playwright test mobile-responsive.spec.ts --project=mobile
scripts.backend:test:db: cd apps/backend_elixir && MIX_ENV=test mix ecto.create --quiet && MIX_ENV=test mix ecto.migrate && RUN_DB_TESTS=true MIX_ENV=test mix test --only db
scripts.backend:check: npm run backend:deps && npm run backend:compile && npm run backend:test:contract
scripts.backend:snapshots:validate-static: cd apps/backend_elixir && mix run --no-start -e 'case StonksBackend.Snapshots.validate_snapshot_tree("../../apps/web/public/public") do :ok -> IO.puts("static snapshots ok"); {:error, reason} -> raise to_string(reason) end'
scripts.test: npm run web:test && npm run backend:check
scripts.test:all: npm run web:test && npm run backend:test && npm run web:e2e
scripts.build: npm run build:map-assets && npm run web:build
